tasks.desktop:dev: npm run build:watch & deno desktop --hmr --backend cef -A desktop/main.ts
tasks.compile:mac-arm64: deno desktop --backend cef -A --target aarch64-apple-darwin --icon desktop/icon/squaredance.png --include dist --include desktop/spike.html --exclude node_modules --exclude-unused-npm -o build/SquareDance.app desktop/main.ts
tasks.compile:mac-x64: deno desktop --backend cef -A --target x86_64-apple-darwin --icon desktop/icon/squaredance.png --include dist --include desktop/spike.html --exclude node_modules --exclude-unused-npm -o build/SquareDance-intel.app desktop/main.ts
tasks.compile:win-x64: deno desktop --backend cef -A --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --icon desktop/icon/squaredance.ico --include dist --include desktop/spike.html --exclude node_modules --exclude-unused-npm -o build/SquareDance.msi desktop/main.ts
tasks.compile:all: npm run build && deno task compile:mac-arm64 && deno task compile:mac-x64 && deno task compile:win-x64
